messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Error deploying with gridGraphics
parts:
I am not sure why the most important part of the failure to build gridGraphics is cut off, but it is:

[2017-04-11T19:34:02.493739195+0000] Building R package: gridGraphics (0.1-5)
/mnt/packages/build /mnt

* installing *source* package ‘gridGraphics’ ...
** package ‘gridGraphics’ successfully unpacked and MD5 sums checked
** R
** inst
** preparing package for lazy loading
Error in system("convert --version", intern = TRUE, ignore.stderr = TRUE) :
  error in running command
Error : unable to load R code in package ‘gridGraphics’
ERROR: lazy loading failed for package ‘gridGraphics’
* removing ‘/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/gridGraphics’

My guess is that "convert" comes from ImageMagick, which is not installed by default. See http://docs.rstudio.com/shinyapps.io/getting-started.html#system-packages for opening an issue or supplying a pull request to support it.
